---
title: ""
pagetitle: "Things to Do"
---

```{=html}
<section class="page-hero page-hero-tall hero-trim trim-things" style="background-image:url('images/bridge.jpg'); background-position:center 64%">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow-lg">Things to Do</p>

    <p class="subtitle">
      We both love the Finger Lakes. Here are a few of our favorite places to eat, drink, hike, and explore while you’re in town.
    </p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-white ttd">
  <div class="ttd-inner">
    <div class="ttd-tabs" role="tablist">
      <button class="ttd-tab is-on" data-tab="food" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Food</button>
      <button class="ttd-tab" data-tab="ice-cream" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Ice Cream</button>
      <button class="ttd-tab" data-tab="coffee" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Coffee</button>
      <button class="ttd-tab" data-tab="wineries" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Wineries</button>
      <button class="ttd-tab" data-tab="hiking-walking-trails" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Hiking &amp; Walking Trails</button>
      <button class="ttd-tab" data-tab="with-kids" role="tab" aria-selected="false">With Kids</button>
    </div>
    <div class="ttd-panel is-on" id="tab-food" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="ttd-list">

      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.fingerlakesciderhouse.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Finger Lakes Cider House</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Interlaken</span></div>
        <p>Cider tastings and a menu made with food from their orchard and nearby farms. We love a slow afternoon here.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.taborafarm.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Tabora Farm</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Dundee</span></div>
        <p>Where we stop for lunch on the way to the Seneca Lake wineries. Soups, sandwiches, baked goods, and South African dishes.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://tburgmainstreetmarket.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Main Street Market</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Trumansburg</span></div>
        <p>Sandwiches, salads, local groceries, and Wide Awake Bakery bread, right on Main Street.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.facebook.com/p/New-York-Pizzeria-100063718954871/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">New York Pizzeria</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Trumansburg</span></div>
        <p>Riley’s favorite New York-style pizza, right on Main Street.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.bickeringtwins.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Bickering Twins</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Tacos, birria quesadillas, and a tequila and mezcal bar.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.gorgers.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Gorgers</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Subs, wraps, and rice bowls, with lots of vegetarian and vegan options.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.theheightsithaca.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">The Heights</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>A dressier dinner spot in Cayuga Heights, with a great wine list.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.saigonkitchenithaca.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Saigon Kitchen</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Our favorite Vietnamese food. It’s great for takeout, too.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://ithacamarket.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ithaca Farmers Market</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Weekend mornings by the water at Steamboat Landing. Lots of prepared food, plus produce, bread, and cider to take home.</p>
      </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ttd-panel" id="tab-ice-cream" role="tabpanel" hidden>
      <div class="ttd-list">

      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://ithacaicecream.square.site/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sweet Melissa’s</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Homemade hard ice cream, soft serve, and lots of vegan flavors.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.trimmersicecream.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Trimmers Ice Cream</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Trumansburg</span></div>
        <p>A family-run shop on Route 96, close to the welcome party.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://spottedduck.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Spotted Duck Creamery</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Penn Yan</span></div>
        <p>Frozen custard made with eggs from their own ducks. It’s rich, and worth the drive.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://cayugalakecreamery.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Cayuga Lake Creamery</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Interlaken &amp; Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Homemade ice cream on Route 89 along Cayuga Lake, with a second shop in downtown Ithaca.</p>
      </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ttd-panel" id="tab-coffee" role="tabpanel" hidden>
      <div class="ttd-list">

      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://gimmecoffee.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Gimme! Coffee</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca &amp; Trumansburg</span></div>
        <p>Ithaca’s own roaster, and the coffee we drink most.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://pressbayalley.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Press Bay Alley</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Coffee and a handful of small shops in a converted alley off West State Street.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.fortyweightcoffee.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Forty Weight Coffee</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>A small-batch roaster with a café in Collegetown, a counter inside GreenStar, and a stall at the farmers market.</p>
      </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ttd-panel" id="tab-wineries" role="tabpanel" hidden>
      <div class="ttd-list">

      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.hosmerwinery.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Hosmer Winery</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ovid</span></div>
        <p>Riley worked here, so we’re biased. We love their Riesling and Cabernet Franc.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.sixeightycellars.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Six Eighty Cellars</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ovid</span></div>
        <p>Small-batch wines aged in clay and concrete, with a long view down Cayuga Lake.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://btfwines.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Bet the Farm</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Trumansburg</span></div>
        <p>A small, women-owned winery just outside Trumansburg.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://sixmilecreek.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Six Mile Creek Vineyard</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>The closest winery to downtown Ithaca, with a distillery too.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.wiemer.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Hermann J. Wiemer</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Dundee</span></div>
        <p>Some of the best Riesling in the Finger Lakes. Their dry Riesling will be on the wine list at our reception.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.drfrankwines.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Dr. Konstantin Frank</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Hammondsport</span></div>
        <p>The longest drive on this list, on Keuka Lake, and one of the oldest wineries in the region.</p>
      </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ttd-panel" id="tab-hiking-walking-trails" role="tabpanel" hidden>
      <div class="ttd-list">

      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://parks.ny.gov/visit/state-parks/taughannock-falls-state-park" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Taughannock Falls</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Trumansburg</span></div>
        <p>A 215-foot waterfall, taller than Niagara, in the same park as the welcome party. The trail to the base is flat and shaded.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://parks.ny.gov/visit/state-parks/watkins-glen-state-park" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watkins Glen State Park</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Watkins Glen</span></div>
        <p>Nineteen waterfalls along a stone gorge trail. It gets busy, so go early.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://parks.ny.gov/visit/state-parks/robert-h-treman-state-park" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Robert H. Treman</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Our pick for a hot day. You can swim at the base of a waterfall in the lower park.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://parks.ny.gov/visit/state-parks/buttermilk-falls-state-park" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Buttermilk Falls</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Close to town and quick if you only have an hour. The trail is wet stone, so wear good shoes.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://cornellbotanicgardens.org/location/beebe-lake-and-woods" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Beebe Lake Loop</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>An easy, shaded one-mile loop around the lake on Cornell’s campus, past a waterfall.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.friendsofstewartpark.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Stewart Park &amp; the Waterfront Trail</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>A flat, paved path along the south end of Cayuga Lake that passes the farmers market.</p>
      </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ttd-panel" id="tab-with-kids" role="tabpanel" hidden>
      <div class="ttd-list">

      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://sciencenter.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sciencenter</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>A hands-on science museum for kids, with an outdoor play area.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.ithacachildrensgarden.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ithaca Children’s Garden</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Three acres of gardens made for climbing and digging.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.museumoftheearth.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Museum of the Earth</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Fossils, a full whale skeleton, and a good rainy-day plan.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.friendsofstewartpark.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Stewart Park Playground</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>A big lakefront playground built for kids of all abilities. The carousel runs all summer.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://www.cayuganaturecenter.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Cayuga Nature Center</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>A six-story treehouse, animals to visit, and miles of trails above the lake.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pick">
        <div class="pick-head"><h4><a href="https://cornellbotanicgardens.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Cornell Botanic Gardens</a></h4><span class="pick-place">Ithaca</span></div>
        <p>Free gardens and an arboretum on campus. Easy to wander with little kids, and beautiful in June.</p>
      </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.ttd-tab').forEach(function (b) {
  b.addEventListener('click', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('.ttd-tab').forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove('is-on'); x.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.ttd-panel').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.remove('is-on'); p.hidden = true; });
    b.classList.add('is-on'); b.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    var p = document.getElementById('tab-' + b.getAttribute('data-tab')); p.classList.add('is-on'); p.hidden = false;
  });
});
</script>

  function show(cat) {
    Object.keys(layers).forEach(function (k) { map.removeLayer(layers[k]); });
    var pts = [inn];
    Object.keys(layers).forEach(function (k) {
      if (cat === 'all' || cat === k) { layers[k].addTo(map); layers[k].eachLayer(function (m) { pts.push(m.getLatLng()); }); }
    });
    map.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(pts).pad(0.12));
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.map-chip').forEach(function (b) {

      b.classList.add('is-on'); show(b.getAttribute('data-cat'));
    });
  });
  show('all');
})();

```
